# CGWire Blog

> > The official blog for CGWire and Kitsu, covering animation production management, pipeline development, and industry best practices.

CGWire develops Kitsu, an open-source production tracker for animation studios. This blog features product updates, technical tutorials for Blender and Python integration, animation production guides, and customer success stories from studios worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Kitsu production tracker
- CGWire platform
- Animation production management
- Blender pipeline integration
- Python automation and scripting
- Asset management workflows
- Production planning and scheduling
- Animation principles and techniques
- Visual storytelling
- Quality control processes
- Look development
- Character animation
- Build in public updates
- Studio case studies
- CG pipeline metadata

## Product Updates & Build in Public

- [Build in Public: December 2025 Update](https://blog.cg-wire.com/build-in-public-december-2025-update): CGWire & Kitsu product updates: v1 release, plugins, schedule features
- [Build in Public: September 2025 Update](https://blog.cg-wire.com/build-in-public-september-2025-update): Kitsu product update: schedule versioning, budget forecasting, Summit news
- [Build in Public: September 2024 Update](https://blog.cg-wire.com/build-in-public-september-2024-update): CGWire & Kitsu updates: SAML/SSO, asset library, team schedule features

## Technical Guides & Pipeline Development

- [Managing Blender File Revisions with a Kitsu Versioning Addon (2026)](https://blog.cg-wire.com/blender-kitsu-versioning-addon): Build Blender addon for Kitsu integration and file version management
- [(2026) How to Export and Share Kitsu Playlists with Python](https://blog.cg-wire.com/share-kitsu-playlists): Python tutorial for exporting Kitsu playlists and previews for client review
- [Files and Nodes Metadata In A CG Pipeline (2026)](https://blog.cg-wire.com/cg-pipeline-files-and-nodes-metadata): Managing metadata in CG pipelines using TOML, YAML, JSON & Zou API
- [Deep Dive Into The Kitsu Hosting Infrastructure](https://blog.cg-wire.com/deep-dive-into-our-hosting-infrastructure): Technical overview of Kitsu cloud hosting and SaaS operations with Flask
- [The Beginner's Guide to Geometry Nodes in Blender 2026](https://blog.cg-wire.com/blender-scripting-geometry-nodes): Beginner tutorial on Blender Geometry Nodes for procedural modeling

## Animation Pipeline & Workflows

- [Texturing and Shading in Animation (2026): Definition, Process & Challenges](https://blog.cg-wire.com/texturing-shading-animation): 3D texturing and shading pipeline: UV mapping to look development
- [Why Retopology Matters for Animation Pipelines](https://blog.cg-wire.com/retopology-animation-blender-guide): Blender retopology workflow guide for production-ready character models

- [Must-know Physics And Mechanics Principles Used In Animation (2026)](https://blog.cg-wire.com/physics-and-mechanics-principles-in-animation): Physics fundamentals for realistic character animation and body mechanics
